title: Coherent formal modules with support proper over the base form Serre subcategories
statement: Let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme, $f:X\to S$ a morphism of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] (so $X$ is Noetherian) and $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals. Each of the following full subcategories $\mathcal C$ of the abelian category $\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module, lem-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-modules-abelian] is a Serre subcategory, i.e. contains $0$ and, for every short exact sequence $0\to\mathcal A\to\mathcal B\to\mathcal C'\to0$ of $\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$, $\mathcal B\in\mathcal C$ if and only if $\mathcal A\in\mathcal C$ and $\mathcal C'\in\mathcal C$: (1) $\mathit{Coh}_{\text{support proper over }S}(X,\mathcal I)$, the objects $(\mathcal F_n)$ with $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F_1)$ proper over $S$ [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base]; (2) the objects $(\mathcal F_n)$ for which there is a closed subscheme $Z\subseteq X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion] with $Z\to S$ proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] and $\mathcal I_Z\mathcal F_n=0$ for all $n\ge1$.
